item.title: MIUI OS4.0.4.0.XPCCNXM Fastboot update for Xiaomi 17 China
item.description:
New Stable Fastboot update available!

Device: Xiaomi 17 China

Codename: pudding

Version: OS4.0.4.0.XPCCNXM | 17.0

Size: 11.8 GB

MD5: 3cef583e466f25b2379238d012b7bff1

Changelog:
[Basic experience]
Reduced system load and memory use for lasting smooth performance
New: Precision workload scheduling helps optimize system-wide performance
Optimization: System workload scheduling handles tasks more efficiently, while redundant instructions have been removed to improve performance and reduce power consumption
Optimization: CPU processing and GPU rendering workloads consume less power
Optimization: Graphics rendering reduces UI power consumption and stuttering
Optimization: Game frequency scaling delivers more stable frame rates in demanding scenarios such as team battles

New: Memory preloading helps apps respond faster
Optimization: Memory reservation and allocation reduce resource use and memory usage after startup
Optimization: Background resource scheduling loads resources only when needed and staggers background tasks to reduce memory use and improve performance
Optimization: Memory preloading and storage prefetching reduce occasional stuttering and frame drops, speed up cold starts, and improve app responsiveness

New: Xiaomi HyperOS app runtime environment helps system apps run more smoothly and use resources more efficiently
Optimization: Home screen and Gallery interactions provide smoother visuals and more responsive controls
Optimization: Gallery and Weather use fewer CPU and memory resources in the background
[Xiaomi Hyper XiaoAi]
Upgraded Xiaomi Hyper XiaoAi now understands you better and makes everyday tasks easier
New interactions:
New: Xiaomi Hyper XiaoAi supports Xiaomi HyperIsland, letting you follow the progress of long-running AI tasks in real time. Notifications automatically expand when tasks are complete.
New: Xiaomi Hyper XiaoAi action bubble. Swipe in from the side and pause to bring it up, then point to on-screen content to ask questions or take action. Drag it to a location to start navigation, or to an event to add it to your calendar.
Optimization: The default Xiaomi Hyper XiaoAi voice sounds more natural
Optimization: The Xiaomi Hyper XiaoAi start page makes it easier to view previous tasks, open your profile, or start a new conversation using the tabs at the bottom
Pro mode:
New: Xiaomi Hyper XiaoAi offers Pro mode for complex and scheduled tasks across apps and devices, with cloud-based tools for document processing and webpage creation
Memories and memory preferences can now sync across phones, tablets, and computers
Transfer files across devices, send files from your computer to your phone, and search for files on other phones, tablets, and computers
Control devices with a single request, such as casting your screen
Create webpages, PowerPoint presentations, Word documents, Excel spreadsheets, and PDFs with a single request, with support for cloud-based file processing such as document format conversion
Phone notifications sync to your tablet and computer in real time, and you can reply from either device using Home screen+
Privacy protection:
New: Xiaomi Hyper XiaoAi includes additional privacy safeguards. AI can control apps and access data only within the permissions you grant, and asks for confirmation before sensitive actions to help prevent unintended operations.
New: Xiaomi Hyper XiaoAi includes a memory management page where you can control what your assistant is allowed to remember. Memories are encrypted and stored locally for greater privacy and control.
[Alive Design Philosophy]
Refreshed system visuals for a more polished look
New: A soft glass material responds to surrounding colors and automatically adjusts its transparency for a more refined look
New: Soft glass lighting effects respond dynamically to your actions for more fluid interactions
New: The Lock screen offers more clock customization options, including text width and height, position, font, and material style
New: Notifications can appear in stacks on the Lock screen and at the bottom of the Notification shade for easier access and smoother animations
New: The Home screen supports widget stacks. Swipe up or down to switch between widgets, with multiple shapes and styles available for a clearer view of information.
New: You can resize Home screen folders by dragging their edges
New: System apps use an adaptive floating layout with a refreshed design that adjusts to different screen sizes for more immersive browsing and clearer navigation
New: Third party apps support seamless transition animations
Optimization: Opening and closing animations for landscape apps and screen rotation animations in multi-window scenarios provide smoother transitions
[Comprehensive system app optimization]
Upgraded core system apps to make them more useful and easier to use
Phone:
New: Added the new AI calls feature for easier call handling
You can now ask Xiaomi Hyper XiaoAi to set when AI should answer incoming calls for you. After each call, AI will automatically summarize the key points.
AI reply suggestions for common calls, such as food delivery and courier calls. Once you confirm a suggestion, AI will reply to the caller by voice.

Notes:
New: Notes supports real-time transcription and automatic summaries for recordings
New: AI Summary offers templates for meetings, interviews, classes, and general use, creating structured summaries that make key points easier to find
New: You can import audio and images from your device and automatically turn their content into AI notes
New: Xiaomi Hyper XiaoAi is available in Notes, letting you ask questions about your content, edit notes, and more
Xiaomi Hyper XiaoAi Keyboard:
New: Voice input uses AI to turn speech into clear, well-structured text
New: AI can generate chat replies based on conversation context, with multiple styles available
New: AI Translate supports typed and voice input for real-time translation between Chinese and English
New: Autofill supports card and ID information
Recorder:
New: Recordings include a timeline outline to help you quickly find and jump to specific parts
New: AI can generate concise summaries of marked key points
New: AI Summary offers templates for meetings and general use, automatically turning recordings into structured summaries
New: Recording playback can automatically skip silent segments for a more streamlined listening experience
Other:
New: File Manager includes "Recently deleted", making it easy to restore deleted files
New: Clipboard shortcuts work in more scenarios. After copying text, you can quickly extract ID information, make calls, start navigation, and more.
New: Mi Mover can now transfer Xiaomi Hyper XiaoAi conversation history and scheduled tasks
New: Xiaomi Cloud backup can now back up photos, messages, contacts, call history, documents, Xiaomi Hyper XiaoAi data, including conversation history and scheduled tasks, WeChat data, including chat history, QQ data, including chat history, and more
New: Optimize recognition in low light. When you add your face data in low light, screen brightness will temporarily increase to improve recognition.
New: You can now submit issues or suggestions simply by chatting with Xiaomi Hyper XiaoAi
Optimization: Calendar shows more relevant event details based on the event type
[Interconnectivity]
New: Xiaomi Smart Hub offers card-based controls, letting you pin frequently used devices, switch between homes with one tap, and control devices across the Human × Car × Home ecosystem more easily
New: Xiaomi Interconnectivity for PC and Mac has been upgraded. Use Xiaomi Hyper XiaoAi to transfer files and sync notifications across your computer, phone, and tablet.
New: Two Xiaomi phones can connect to each other, allowing calls and SMS verification codes to sync between them. You can handle calls and messages on either phone and quickly copy recognized content with one tap.
Go to Settings > Interconnectivity > Cross-device notifications > Receive, select another Xiaomi phone signed in to the same Xiaomi Account, turn on call and message notifications, and make sure both phones are connected to the internet
[Privacy and security]
New: Secure access to photos and videos supports albums and smart search, making it easier to find the content you want
New: You can reset your screen lock if you forget it. Within 96 hours of adding a fingerprint, use your previous screen lock and fingerprint to set a new one.
[Other]
Visit our website to learn more: https://hyperos.mi.com/

Download: Here

item.title: MIUI OS3.0.3.0.WPCTWXM Recovery update for Xiaomi 17 Taiwan
item.description:
New Stable Beta Recovery update available!

Device: Xiaomi 17 Taiwan

Codename: pudding

Version: OS3.0.3.0.WPCTWXM | 16.0

Size: 7.5 GB

MD5: 4b6f32af9b452ea6c36284a6eff1d077

Changelog:
[Xiaomi HyperIsland]
Everything you need to keep an eye on. In one place.
A new format that combines Notification spotlight and device notifications makes any important updates reach you faster.
New UI design lets you see all the details at a glance, with smoother switching between islands.
Now you can pull down to expand small windows and handle multiple tasks more efficiently.
[Revamped visuals]
Cleaner, more refined visuals throughout.
Redesigned Home screen icons now look sharper and more detailed.
The Home screen grid has been redesigned with more balanced margins and more comfortable spacing.
The status bar has a new, cleaner design that's more refined and easier to read.
A new design system improves color comfort, unifies rounded corners across the entire system, and makes controls easier to use for a more consistent look and feel.
A new large-clock Lock screen adds more depth and layers to the layout.
A new all-in-one editor allows you to adjust both the Home screen and Lock screen wallpapers at the same time.
[Comprehensive system app optimization]
Interaction with apps has become more intuitive and direct.
Gallery:
New: New Gallery widgets allow you to select your preferred collections for display.
New: You can pin albums now to have quick access to your favorite photos anytime.
Optimization: Improved search for quicker, more accurate results for photos.

Weather:
Optimization: All-new start page rendering with raindrop and temperature effects that are dynamic and interactive.
Optimization: Improved content card blur effects for a smoother, more immersive scrolling experience.

Calendar:
New: Week view gives you a clear look at your weekly schedule.
Optimization: Improved month-view visuals give you clearer highlights for holidays and important events.

Recorder:
Optimization: Accurate start page categories let you locate recordings faster with icons.
Optimization: Improved playback brings you smart noise reduction for clearer voices.
[Interconnectivity]
Cross-ecosystem interconnectivity offers deep compatibility with the Apple ecosystem.
iPad interconnectivity:
New: Home screen+ enables Xiaomi phones to mirror screen content to your iPad.

Mac interconnectivity:
You can connect to your Xiaomi phone via hotspot in one tap and view its location on a Mac.
Now you can open multiple phone apps simultaneously and adjust their window sizes.

Cross-device unlocking:
Use the fingerprint or password on your Xiaomi tablet to unlock your Xiaomi phone.
Unlock your Xiaomi phone quickly using Touch ID, Face ID, or password on an iPhone, iPad, or Mac.

Interconnectivity availability:
* To use interconnectivity with Apple devices, update them to iOS 14, iPadOS 14, or macOS 12 or later.
* Apple devices must have the latest version of Xiaomi Interconnectivity installed.
[Basic experience]
Smoother and more stable
Performance enhancements:
Optimization: Refined compiler instructions enhance performance and responsiveness while lowering power use.
Optimization: Improved memory allocation and recovery increases available system memory.
Optimization: Improved integrated frequency scheduling boosts system efficiency and reduces power consumption.
Optimization: Improved short-video playback efficiency for better battery life.

Optimized graphics:
A new window-rendering mechanism reduces graphics-rendering load.

Smoother system animations:
Optimization: Fine-tuned animations across 100+ system scenes for smoother, more natural motion.
[Privacy and security]
Enhanced protection keeps your data private and safe.
The system's privacy and password features have been redesigned with a cleaner, fresher interface.
Advanced data protection now uses post-quantum encryption to keep personal data even more secure.

Download: Here
